newsitem.title: USA: Eckler expects 14 pct rise in 1996 sales.
newsitem.headline: Eckler expects 14 pct rise in 1996 sales.

text.p: Eckler Industries Inc said Wednesday it expects this year's sales to increase 14 percent over sales in the 1995 fiscal year.
The company did not disclose its sales for the 1995 fiscal year, and did not immediately return a telephone call seeking that information.
In the third quarter ended June 30, the company reported revenues of $5.05 million up from $4.29 million during the same period in the previous year.
The company also said it had closed on a $2.4 million real estate mortgage with Barnett Banks Inc on September 30. It said the bank also extended the company a $1 million line of credit.
Eckler provides AC/Declo parts in the Corvette aftermarket and restoration.
Eckler said early Wednesday afternoon that its net sales for the 1995 fiscal year were $12.93 million.
